ov: الرداء الأبيض هو فيلم مصري عرض عام 1975، بطولة نجلاء فتحي وأحمد مظهر ومجدي وهبة ويوسف وهبي.
plotEn: Omar Bey's son Kamal fell in love and married a lady called Dalal. The marriage by Kamal was not approved by his father. Kamal died in an accident. His father Omar Bey drove Dalal out of the house after the death of her husband and took up responsibility of looking after her daughter. Later on, Dalal decides to steal from Omar Bay to buy some gifts for her daughter.
